description.name: Entry
description.text:
7 single-target Fire/Ice/Lightning/NE physical attacks at Cap Break Level 1, En-Fire, En-Ice or En-Lightning Stack, Cap Break Level 1 & Crystal Mode to user
Crystal Mode: Spellblade Ability Boost, Dualcast Spellblade, Zero Hone Cost to Spellblade Abilities & 25% DEF/RES Pierce
Crystal Force I/II: 4 single-target Fire/Ice/Lightning/NE physical attacks at Cap Break Level 1, Instant Cast, [Cap Break Level 2, Spellblade Damage +30%, Quick ATB & 50% DEF/RES Pierce] for 1 turn to user; After using Crystal Force II, chases with 2 single-target Fire/Ice/Lightning/NE Overflow physical attack, Quick/Instant Spellblade 1 & Triple/Quadracast Spellblade 1 to user with at least 0/3 Spellblades in party
